_comment: No Figma component — in blocked_on_figma since 2026-08-19. Built from the Frontend per the amended authority rule (2026-08-20). A section heading: optional icon + title over a primary-red underline, then a secondary underline running the rest of the row.

_source.underline-padding: `pb-1` = 4px between text and its rule, on both segments.
_source.accent-color / rule-color: `border-primary` under the text, `border-secondary` under the rest of the row.
_source.title: TYPOGRAPHY_SIZE.title_l_semb = the system's title.lg.semibold role.
_source.colors: titleColor prop: primary | secondary, mapping to text.primary/secondary.

_frontend_evidence.implementation: flex items-end; [icon+title over border-primary] then [flex-1 border-secondary]

_verified_from.scope: token mirror searched for underline; frontend component read in full
_verified_from.result: VERIFIED ABSENT in Figma. Frontend is the authority per the amended rule (user decision 2026-08-20).
